name: @cinatra-ai/google-appointment-schedules-connector
description: Manage Google Calendar appointment-schedule booking links, each tied to the calendar that owns its availability

configSchema.title: Google Appointment Schedules
configSchema.description: Manage the Google Calendar appointment-schedule booking links the assistant can share, each tied to the Google Calendar that owns its availability.

fields.label: Appointment schedules
fields.emptyState: No appointment schedules yet. Paste a booking page link below to add one.
fields.description: Booking-page links the assistant can share, each tied to the calendar that owns its availability. Deleting a row is host-authorized.

fields.label: Booking page URL
fields.description: A public Google Calendar appointment-schedule link (calendar.app.google/…) — a share link, not a calendar sync. See the Help tab for how to get one.

fields.label: Calendar
fields.placeholder: No connected calendars yet — connect Google Calendar at /connectors/cinatra-ai/google-calendar-connector/setup to see your calendars here.
fields.description: The Google Calendar this schedule's availability comes from. Leave unset to use your primary calendar.

fields.label: About booking pages
fields.whenReady: A public Google Calendar appointment-schedule link (calendar.app.google/…) the assistant shares so people can book time with you — a share link, not a calendar sync. Get one in Google Calendar: Create → Appointment schedule, then paste its public link here.
fields.whenNotReady: A public Google Calendar appointment-schedule link (calendar.app.google/…) the assistant shares so people can book time with you — a share link, not a calendar sync. Get one in Google Calendar: Create → Appointment schedule, then paste its public link here.
fields.description: Read-only setup guidance — nothing on this tab is saved.
